hits.snippet: Tec-Do Launches AI-Powered Marketing Agent Workflow - AI & Robotic ... Guangzhou-based AI startup Tec-Do Technology has unveiled its Navos 2.0 platform, featuring a multi-agent marketing workflow designed for global ad optimization. Partnering with OpenAI, the system utilizes a 300-billion-parameter model called Tec-Chi, which leads global benchmarks in marketing capability. The architecture, described as Yin-Yang, combines high-level reasoning with continuous streams of real-time market data from major social and e-commerce platforms. By deploying approximately 2,000 autonomous agents daily, the system manages creative generation, influencer matching, and performance analysis. A rigorous double-blind feedback loop ensures constant optimization of ad ROI. Tec-Do effectively establishes a new vertical AI operating system for modern digital marketing.
